exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) following cesarean delivery but before hysterectomy
outcome: length of intensive care unit (ICU) stay
cohort: 31 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
finding: In patients with placenta increta, uterine artery embolization (UAE) following cesarean delivery but before hysterectomy appears to be safe and effective in decreasing estimated blood loss, transfusion requirements, and length of ICU stay compared with cesarean-hysterectomy alone.
